title: Split MCP config into per-machine local file
description:
## Context

## Context

Different laptops use different MCP servers (Coda, Atlassian, Figma, etc.), but the `opencode.json` is git-tracked — causing conflicts across machines.

**Goal:** Move all MCP definitions out of the tracked `opencode.json` into a gitignored local-only file (`opencode.local.json`), and add Coda MCP as part of the initial local config.

OpenCode supports config merging across multiple locations (global → custom → project). We'll use `OPENCODE_CONFIG` env var pointing to `opencode.local.json` for machine-specific overrides.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `opencode.json` no longer contains `"mcp"` block
- [ ] `opencode.local.json` exists with MCP definitions (atlassian, figma, coda)
- [ ] `opencode.local.json` is gitignored
- [ ] Coda MCP uses `{env:CODA_API_KEY}` (no hardcoded secrets)
- [ ] Instructions/README note added about per-machine MCP setup

## Skills

- beads-workflow
- stack-typescript

## Branch

`epic/split-mcp-config`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] (fill in)

## Notes

(none)

title: Remove MCP block from opencode.json and create opencode.local.json
description:
## Context

## Context

The tracked `opencode.json` currently has an `"mcp"` block with atlassian and figma servers. This needs to move to a local-only file.

## Skills

- beads-workflow
- stack-typescript

## Branch

`epic/split-mcp-config`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Remove the entire `"mcp": { ... }` block from `opencode.json`
- [ ] Create `opencode.local.json` with the following content:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "mcp": {
    "atlassian": {
      "type": "remote",
      "url": "https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp",
      "enabled": true,
      "timeout": 30000
    },
    "figma": {
      "type": "remote",
      "url": "https://mcp.figma.com/mcp",
      "enabled": true,
      "timeout": 30000
    },
    "coda": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "coda-mcp@latest"],
      "env": {
        "API_KEY": "{env:CODA_API_KEY}"
      },
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```
- [ ] Add `opencode.local.json` to `.gitignore`

## Notes

- Do NOT hardcode any API keys — use `{env:CODA_API_KEY}` variable substitution
- The `.gitignore` currently ignores itself (line 4: `.gitignore`), so just append `opencode.local.json` to it
- OpenCode merges configs: global (`opencode.json`) + custom (`OPENCODE_CONFIG`) — so the split works seamlessly

## Skills

- beads-workflow
- stack-typescript

## Branch

`epic/split-mcp-config`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] (fill in)

## Notes

(none)
